name: Bhagavad Gita 12.13–14
text:
अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च ।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी ॥
सन्तुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः ।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः ॥
meaning: One who bears no ill will to any being, who is friendly and compassionate, free of possessiveness and pride, even in sorrow and joy, forgiving, content, steady, self-controlled and firm in resolve, with mind and understanding given to me: that devotee is dear to me.
purpose: Friendliness, compassion, freedom from malice and forgiveness (verses 13 and 14).
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
